description: Adds a document to a DRAFT signature request. Requires: signature_request_create → requestId, case_file_create → caseFileId. Give the document a new UUID as `id` (it is the documentId for coordinates and certificates) and the SHA-256 hex `hash` of its exact bytes. Without `fileUrl` it returns `url`, a presigned upload URL: PUT the exact bytes there with header x-amz-checksum-sha256 = base64 of the same SHA-256. With `fileUrl` (HTTPS) the tool downloads the file itself (size and private-network guards), refuses before registering anything if it does not match `hash` (telling you the right one), and uploads it. Processing is asynchronous: poll signature_document_list until the document is READY_TO_SIGN (ERROR: the bytes or the registration failed). A registered document that never receives its bytes stays PENDING and blocks activation. convertToPdf only for a file name ending in .docx. Not after activate_signature_request. For CONFIGURABLE sequence: `groupId` must reference a Document type group (not Signatory or DocumentSignatory) — a wrong group type returns 'Signature group not found'. To create, fill and send a request in one call, use signature_request_full.

convertToPdf.description: Convert non-PDF to PDF before processing

fileUrl.description: Optional public URL to download and auto-upload the PDF to S3. Eliminates the manual PUT step.

groupId.description: For CONFIGURABLE sequence: ID of a Document type group

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the PDF content (64 hex chars)

id.description: UUID for the document — becomes documentId for coordinate_set and certificate_get

name: signature_request_add_document
